advancement.magicclover.root.title: Beginner's Luck
advancement.magicclover.root.description: Get your first four-leaf clover. Grass, logs, ore and chests all drop them.
advancement.magicclover.tier_basic.title: Grass
advancement.magicclover.tier_basic.descr: Get a basic clover. This is where everything starts. Don't be sad about the dirt.
advancement.magicclover.tier_wood.title: Lumberjack
advancement.magicclover.tier_wood.descri: Get a wooden clover. Only naturally generated logs count.
advancement.magicclover.tier_coal.title: Coal Miner
advancement.magicclover.tier_lapis.title: Lapis Blue
advancement.magicclover.tier_iron.title: Ironclad Luck
advancement.magicclover.tier_iron.descri: Get an iron clover. The loot starts being useful here.
advancement.magicclover.tier_gold.title: All That Glitters
advancement.magicclover.tier_diamond.des: Get a diamond clover. Three rolls, and it can carry your whole run.
advancement.magicclover.tier_netherite.d: Get a netherite clover. 1.5% from ancient debris.
advancement.magicclover.all_tiers.title: Perfect Ten
advancement.magicclover.all_tiers.descri: Own all ten tiers at least once.
advancement.magicclover.mod_clover.title: Someone Else's Mod
advancement.magicclover.mod_clover.descr: Get a mod clover. It pulls items from every other mod you have installed.
advancement.magicclover.mob_clover.title: Petting Zoo
advancement.magicclover.mob_clover.descr: Get a mob clover. Watch out for creepers.
advancement.magicclover.bundle.title: Schrodinger's Bundle
advancement.magicclover.bundle.descripti: Get a random clover bundle. Nobody knows the tier until it's opened.
advancement.magicclover.lesser_potion.de: Get a lucky tonic. 20% event chance for 60 seconds.
advancement.magicclover.event_potion.des: Get an event potion. 50% event chance for 120 seconds.
